What information was incorrect, unhelpful, or incomplete?

The Element: input event page has the following breadcrumbs:

  • Web
  • Web APIs
  • Element
  • input

This confused me a bit, because input is also an HTML element, which has the following breadcrumbs:

  • Web
  • HTML
  • Reference
  • Elements
  • <input>

What did you expect to see?

I would expect the breadcrumb leaf for the event page to has an indicator, such as "input event" or "input (event)".
